case when collector.clct_dt < to_char(collector.clct_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:15')::timestamp then to_char(collector.clct_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:15') when collector.clct_dt < to_char(collector.clct_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:30')::timestamp then to_char(collector.clct_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:30') when collector.clct_dt < to_char(collector.clct_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:45')::timestamp then to_char(collector.clct_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:35') else to_char(collector.clct_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:00') end as time

select
, substring(cgslam.adstdg_cd, 0, 5) as sggCd , sum(collector.trfvlm) as trfVol from adsi_vds_sctn_stlink_mppg avssm inner join adsi_vds_sctn_info avsi on avssm.vds_sctn_id = avsi.vds_sctn_id inner join adsi_vds_colct_info_cur collector on avsi.vds_id = collector.vds_id inner join c_gm_std_link_tmp cgsl on avssm.std_link_id = cgsl.link_id inner join c_gm_std_link_adstdg_mppg cgslam on cgsl.link_id = cgslam.link_id
group by 1,2 order by 1

select
, substring(cgslam.adstdg_cd, 0, 5) as sggCd , /*round(avg(collector.avg_vhcl_speed), 2) as SPEED*/ sum(collector.vhcl_trfvlm) as trfVol from adsi_smcrsrd_crsrd_acs_road_info ascari inner join adsi_smcrsrd_crsrd_acs_road_stats_fivmin_cur collector on ascari.acs_road_id = collector.acs_road_id inner join c_gm_std_link_tmp cgsl on ascari.link_id = cgsl.link_id inner join c_gm_std_link_adstdg_mppg cgslam on cgsl.link_id = cgslam.link_id
group by 1,2 order by 1

select
, substring(cgslam.adstdg_cd, 0, 5) as sggCd , round(avg(collector.avg_speed), 2) as avgSpeed from adsi_vds_sctn_stlink_mppg avssm inner join adsi_vds_sctn_info avsi on avssm.vds_sctn_id = avsi.vds_sctn_id inner join adsi_vds_colct_info_cur collector on avsi.vds_id = collector.vds_id inner join c_gm_std_link_tmp cgsl on avssm.std_link_id = cgsl.link_id inner join c_gm_std_link_adstdg_mppg cgslam on cgsl.link_id = cgslam.link_id
group by 1,2 order by 1

select
, substring(cgslam.adstdg_cd, 0, 5) as sggCd , round(avg(collector.avg_vhcl_speed), 2) as avgSpeed from adsi_smcrsrd_crsrd_acs_road_info ascari inner join adsi_smcrsrd_crsrd_acs_road_stats_fivmin_cur collector on ascari.acs_road_id = collector.acs_road_id inner join c_gm_std_link_tmp cgsl on ascari.link_id = cgsl.link_id inner join c_gm_std_link_adstdg_mppg cgslam on cgsl.link_id = cgslam.link_id

, substring(cgslam.adstdg_cd, 0, 5) as sggCd, round(avg(collector.speed), 2) as avgSpeed from adsi_dsrc_sctn_stlink_mppg adssm inner join adsi_dsrc_colct_info_cur collector on adssm.dsrc_sctn_id = collector.dsrc_sctn_id inner join c_gm_std_link_tmp cgsl on adssm.std_link_id = cgsl.link_id inner join c_gm_std_link_adstdg_mppg cgslam on cgsl.link_id = cgslam.link_id
